summary: A wide shot captures a film set with a green screen background, featuring a raised platform with two actors and various production equipment.

visuals.description: A wide shot of a film set shows a raised wooden platform with stone-like architectural elements and a railing against a large green screen. One actor is lying down, covered, on the platform, while another actor is sitting, holding a rifle. Various film lighting equipment, including large softboxes, are positioned around the set, and a crew member is visible in the foreground looking at a monitor.

technical_notes: boom pole visible at top center of frame
